d.title: The views, the plot, the surrounding

Ricefields surrounding —
every villa opens to 360°
d.body: Defined by elevation, proximity to developments, and return potential. Not an isolated location — an evolving environment, with hospitality, infrastructure and residential developments nearby.

d.title: Signature villas
d.body: Road access, secured private parking. Co-working & community space. Recovery pool, sauna & ice bath — shared spaces surrounded by ricefields and tropical jungle.

d.title:
Your own
Balinese-inspired retreat
d.body: Built with sustainable materials and high-quality finishes. Unlimited access to the stunning organically designed central pool that flows through the heart of the resort.

d.title: Pool terrace, teak wood, authentic materials
d.body: Alang alang roofing, teak wood structure and authentic local materials define the constructive style of every villa — the same tropical minimalism that runs through the whole resort.

d.title: Comfort first, tropical minimal
d.body:
Comfort first. The essentials should feel right from the very first use.

Tropical minimal. Fewer pieces, better materials, and a cleaner visual reading.

Operational ease. Everything should be easy to clean, restock, and maintain.

Guest perception. Small details greatly elevate the overall experience.

d.title:
Light, warm,
easy to maintain
d.body: Comfortable sofa, coffee table, television with streaming, high-speed Wi-Fi, dining table & chairs, warm lighting, minimal and welcoming décor, workstation, plants, local art. Where comfort, good light and a clean aesthetic come together.

d.title: A hotel-like feeling
d.body: Main bed with solid structure, high-comfort hotel mattress, 300-thread-count bed linen, blackout + sheer curtains. Defines the perception of rest — the priority is not only beauty, but visual calm, the right textiles, and an impeccable bed.

d.title: Clean and calm
d.body: Soft cotton towel set, mirror with clean presence, essential amenity set, hair dryer and guest support. More than a utility space — it reinforces the perception of care, comfort and hospitality.

d.title:
Fresh, complete
and naturally inviting
d.body: Refrigerator with freezer, complete tableware set, cookware and utensils, coffee & tea station. Fully equipped, thoughtful material choices, and a well-proportioned island.

d.title: Land legacy
d.body: Freehold turnkey villa with private pool. Common areas, co-working, community pool, parking area and roads.
